model.baseDefense: Raw hero definitions with inheritance. These values precede attributes and innate ability modifiers.
assumptions: Single stationary target with zero armor and evasion. Continuous attacks with no downtime.
Models natural attribute growth as base plus (level minus one) times gain. Keeps fractional values before engine rounding.
No items, abilities, innates, passives, procs, special attack modes, talents, Attribute Bonus skill points, or other modifiers.

heroes.name: Morphling
heroes.scenarioNote: Uses unshifted attributes. Attribute Shift is excluded.

heroes.name: Tiny
heroes.scenarioNote: Uses zero natural agility growth. Grow, Tree Grab, and hero-specific attack modifiers are excluded.

heroes.name: Chen
heroes.scenarioNote: Hero attack only. The starting Zealot and controlled units are excluded.

heroes.name: Lone Druid
heroes.scenarioNote: Hero attack only. Spirit Bear and True Form are excluded.

heroes.name: Medusa
heroes.scenarioNote: Uses the raw hero definition. Mana Shield changes actual survivability.

heroes.name: Troll Warlord
heroes.scenarioNote: Uses the ranged hero definition. Melee stance and stacking attack speed are excluded.

heroes.name: Void Spirit
heroes.scenarioNote: Intrinsic Edge is excluded. The patch notes describe stats with the innate active.

heroes.name: Kez
heroes.scenarioNote: Uses the client hero definition and its 1.9-second attack time. Sai stance and weapon abilities are excluded.
